raw_segments.text: So cried Ahab, once more hailing a ship showing English colors, bearing down under the stern.
Trumpet to mouth, the old man was standing in his hoisted quarter boat, his ivory leg
plainly revealed to the stranger captain, who was carelessly reclining in his own boat's
He was a darkly tanned, burly, good-natured, fine-looking man, of sixty or thereabouts,
dressed in a spacious roundabout, that hung round him in festoons of blue pilot cloth,
and one empty arm of this jacket streamed behind him like the broidered arm of a Hazar's
